motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Navigation color, primary action background, and arrow translation.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove CSS transitions; freeze the scan and snap the landing camera to chapter states.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Dark rectangular action with a pill arrow inset.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:28px; padding:7px 7px 7px 18px; border-radius:var(--radius-md,12px); background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff30,#ffffff1a),var(--control-solid,#1f1f29); border:1px solid #282834; color:var(--surface,#fefffc); font:500 13px var(--font-ui,Inter,sans-serif); min-height:48px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-pill,0 1px 1px #0000000a); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 250ms; } .ds-disc { width:40px; height:28px; border-radius:50.5px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff29,#ffffff14); border:1px solid #ffffff33; display:grid; place-items:center; transition:transform 250ms; } .ds-primary:hover { background-color:#34343f; } .ds-primary:hover .ds-disc { transform:translateX(2px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink,#2c2c2c); outline-offset:3px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-primary,.ds-disc { transition:none; } }

components.name: Text action
components.description: Quiet inline action with a stroke arrow.
components.html: <button class="ds-text">Inspect the truck<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-text { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:0; border:0; background:none; color:var(--foreground,#171717); font:400 13px var(--font-ui,Inter,sans-serif); min-height:44px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-text:hover { color:var(--accent,#0081c0); } .ds-text:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink,#2c2c2c); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Glass navigation
components.description: Floating warm glass with an inset destination link.
components.html: Console
components.css: .ds-nav { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; padding:4px 8px 4px 24px; border-radius:var(--radius-md,12px); background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f9faf7b8,#f9faf794); border:1px solid #ffffff80; backdrop-filter:blur(9px); box-shadow:var(--shadow-float,0 2px 6px #00000026); white-space:nowrap; } .ds-nav button,.ds-nav a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:40px; padding:0; border:0; background:none; font:500 13px var(--font-ui,Inter,sans-serif); color:var(--ink-secondary,#444141); text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:color 250ms; } .ds-nav a { background:#ffffff6b; padding:0 12px; border-radius:8px; } .ds-nav button:hover,.ds-nav a:hover { color:var(--accent,#0081c0); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible,.ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink,#2c2c2c); outline-offset:3px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-nav button,.ds-nav a { transition:none; } }

components.name: Inspection hotspot
components.description: A part label over the shared truck illustration.
components.css: .ds-hotspot { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font:400 11px var(--font-ui,Inter,sans-serif); color:var(--foreground,#171717); min-height:44px; padding:0 10px 0 6px; border:0; background:#fefffcdb; border-radius:8px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-float,0 2px 6px #00000026); backdrop-filter:blur(15px); cursor:pointer; } .ds-dot { width:26px; height:26px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:1px solid #adbeaf; border-radius:50%; } .ds-hotspot:hover,.ds-hotspot[aria-pressed="true"] { color:#006393; } .ds-hotspot[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-dot { background:var(--accent,#0081c0); border-color:var(--accent,#0081c0); color:#fff; } .ds-hotspot:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink,#2c2c2c); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Console panel
components.description: Readable activity container with a quiet empty state.
components.css: .ds-panel { border-radius:var(--radius-lg,16px); overflow:hidden; background:var(--surface,#fefffc); color:var(--foreground,#171717); box-shadow:var(--shadow-card,0 1px 8px #0000000d); font-family:var(--font-ui,Inter,sans-serif); min-width:260px; } .ds-panel h2 { margin:0; padding:20px 24px 16px; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; color:var(--ink,#2c2c2c); letter-spacing:-.15px; } .ds-panel p { margin:0; padding:10px 24px 24px; color:var(--ink-muted,#646464); font-size:13px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.65; }

narrative.northStar: Quiet intelligence in a working yard
narrative.overview:
Firefly uses the user-approved General Intelligence Company reference as its visual authority: warm white and sage-tinted surfaces, restrained ink typography, glass navigation, and clear rectangular controls. The result should feel calm, precise, and physically grounded.

The shared system serves a persuasive landing page and an operational console. Their density and composition differ; typography, materials, controls, and the original procedural truck remain recognizably related. Pixelated imagery and pixel icons are excluded by the user.
keyCharacteristics: Warm light surfaces and restrained ink contrast.
Inter at regular and medium weights for interface typography.
Soft glass navigation and rectangular actions with a pill-shaped arrow inset.
An original code-rendered industrial yard with an illustrative sensing accent.

rules.name: The Source Palette Rule
rules.body: Reuse the CSS palette for interface surfaces. Truck, yard, and operational status materials remain scene-local values; do not promote every material swatch to a global UI token.

rules.name: The Quiet Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use regular and medium Inter as the default; establish emphasis with scale and placement before adding heavier weights.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep shadows shallow and functional. Do not substitute luminous glow or dramatic card lifts for the established tonal hierarchy.

dos: Do reuse the shared CSS tokens and the same Truck component across both surfaces.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, readable labels, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do identify simulation and illustration clearly; only operational events may imply operational outcomes.
Do reserve blue sensing marks for the approved illustrative scan, route, and inspection treatments.
donts: Don't introduce pixelated artwork or pixel icons.
Don't turn the pinned oversized Firefly wordmark into the default heading scale.
Don't add entrance animation or decorative parallax to the interface.
Don't claim the procedural vehicle reproduces an exact Aurora sensor configuration or demonstrates real autonomy, sensing accuracy, performance, or safety certification.
